notes: Stories validated; no duplicates; aligned to schema, logic, API, tests, integration.

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Proximity Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define structured schema for trial site proximity including distance (miles/km), travel duration (minutes), origin/destination coordinates, and calculation metadata.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Calculation Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Implement core logic to compute distance and estimated travel time between user location and trial sites, including input normalization, coordinate validation, and fallback handling for missing or partial location data.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Integrate Google Routes API for Travel Metrics
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Integrate Google Routes API to retrieve real-world travel distance and duration, including retry logic, error handling, rate limiting safeguards, and graceful degradation when API responses fail or are unavailable.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial responses, ensuring compatibility with existing clinical trials schema and consistent response formatting for downstream consumers.

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculation
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering distance and duration calculations, edge cases with missing or invalid location data, Google Routes API failure scenarios, and end-to-end validation through the evaluate care facade.
